report.explanation: Current telemetry does not substantiate the operator's deployment hypothesis. Traces show all checkout, order, payment, inventory and postgres spans returning 200 with no errors. Gateway and order metrics show zero 502s on /v1/checkout and /v1/orders. The only deployment record is baseline order v1.0.0 with no previous version, so it cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No bounded cause is established; hand off.
missing_evidence: Error logs or error spans showing actual checkout failures (logs-order, logs-gateway were excluded)
Deployment records for gateway and other services, including any version change preceding the alert
Metrics or traces showing nonzero error status (5xx) on checkout path
Timeline correlating any deployment event with observed error onset
